Name: Owen Wilson Ostrich
Author: 404neely
Description:
Have you ever wanted more Owen Wilson on your farm?? If so, look no further!

Instead of Ostriches making their generic boring cry, they'll instead make a random Owen Wilson "Wow", chosen from a pool of 10 specially curated wows. 

Uses Content Patcher, tested with Stardew Valley version 1.6.15
